## 6ebcd82f8e83

**Classification: Reproduced defect, plus a restricted-geometry concern. No source changes were made.**

Source identity: generator SHA-256 `b7617c4d68782beaf15820e8cad7173a1e576267e46d84e5df32348be39e6c6a`; canonical rule hash `a9a3efecb347`.

All three advertised exact geometry controls are ignored. For seed/sample `0/0` in easy mode, requesting the low and high endpoints of `grid_h` (`5`/`12`), `grid_w` (`6`/`14`), or `bbox_side` (`2`/`9`) produces the same byte-identical `6×8` grid with bbox `[1,3,4,6]`; an unknown key is also accepted. The official override matrix reports 43,014 findings over 56,250 draws. Evidence: `checks/audit/6ebcd82f8e83/contract-probe.json` and `checks/audit/6ebcd82f8e83/override/checks/6ebcd82f8e83_before_override_results.json`.

The hard-mode sampler also violates its own declared bounds: in 100 samples at seed `271828`, 84 had height above the declared `grid_h <= 12` or width above `grid_w <= 14`; the first witness is a `14×14` grid at sample index 0. Across 300 samples, every input contained both top-left and bottom-right bbox markers, so the symmetric anti-diagonal-only anchor case is never taught even though the bbox Racket rule can handle it. The latter is a domain-coverage concern rather than a demonstrated label error.

Checks performed: source and canonical rule review; lint; defect lint; full exact-override matrix; unknown-key probe; 300-sample anchor/bounds census; and rule-source divergence inspection. Lint failed for the missing rule hash; defect lint reported dead textures, an overpermissive self-check, and behavior-equivalent unsynchronized rule text. The task was left unchanged as required.

Existing provisional/unsafe labels unchanged; no approved source reopened.
